title: FTC Team 12589 photo-based display reconstruction
classification: New procedural display mesh reconstructed from local photographs; not original manufacturing CAD
scope: Geometry/material deliverable for the main agent's common studio-render pipeline. Does not replace real project evidence, photographs, the homepage or models/real.

cad_search.result: No identifiable FTC assembly/CAD found in the searched local trees. Desktop/STL contains Brake, Bucketbot, Guitar Education, Line_Follower, Pool Sniper, Smelly and Telecaster; those assemblies are not this FTC robot. No unrelated CAD transplanted as FTC geometry.

existing_procedural_reference.use: Cross-check only: four mecanum wheels, aluminum structure, lift/claw and black control hub. Existing model is too simplified for the requested photographic cover; no geometry copied or presented as CAD.

Gray-silver slotted slide rails with restrained satin reflections.
Silver screws, exposed shafts and couplers.

Red tape bands around white claw and structural links, red cable insulation.
Blue physical deposit cradle and printed wire bracket, not a recolored control hub.

reconstruction_limits: Topology is newly built for a static display render. No original FTC CAD was found, imported or altered.

Overall dimensions, hole patterns and counts, fastener positions, exact wheel rim/roller profile, hidden backside, wiring route and gearbox internals are inferred. Not suitable for fabrication, engineering measurement or kinematic claims.

Combines clearly photographed mechanism details with the completed competition machine's A-frame and color scheme. A partially extended display pose is selected for legibility; it is not a measured reconstruction of one exact instant.

Recognizable visible structure is retained: open perforated aluminum channels, inclined multistage mast, black triangular supports, exposed silver motors, belt runs, string winch, curved white/red-taped intake jaws, blue/red deposit support and thin red lower panels.
PBR values are visual estimates from differently lit images, not spectrophotometer measurements. Real image colors/material families are preserved without introducing an invented paint scheme.
No logos, supplier badges, sponsor names, fabricated labels, trophy geometry or external game/field objects are added.

integration.build_api: Import build_ftc.py under Blender Python and call build(); returns only mesh objects with assigned materials. No scene reset, lights, camera or floor in build().
integration.blender_coordinates: Z-up, nominal metres, XY bounding-box center zero, bottom z=0. All modifiers/curves/transforms baked.
integration.glb_coordinates: Standard glTF Y-up on disk (export_yup=True); Blender glTF import restores Z-up. Units metres. No camera/lights/floor exported.

recommended_view.note: Three-quarter intake-side view. Keep both curved jaws and inclined mast in frame; adjust shared pipeline crop to the full mesh bounds.

integration.large_proof: Add --large to --preview for a 1600x1067 proof. Proof is CPU Cycles, 4 threads, 24 samples. Main agent owns final studio lights and camera.
